newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-SERIE A PLAYERS SET UP "OSCAR" AWARDS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SERIE A PLAYERS SET UP "OSCAR" AWARDS.

text.p: Italy's serie A soccer players are to have their own "Oscars".
The Italian Players' Association (AIC) said on Tuesday that it was asking serie A players to honour the colleagues they most admire.
The categories are Best Player, Best Foreign Player, Best Coach, Best Young Player, Best Sports Programme, Best Goalkeeper and Best Referee.
AIC spokesman Nicola Bosio said voting forms were being sent to players and a statue would be awarded to the winners at a ceremony later this year.
"We'll have a big party," he said.
